description: This file defines an interface for configuration properties related to a MessageMapper. It includes methods to access configuration properties, conditions, and content-type blocklists, as well as nested builder interface for constructing configuration instances.

classes.name: MessageMapperConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for message mapper configuration properties, allowing retrieval of properties, conditions, blocklists, and JSON representations.

classes.name: MessageMapperConfiguration.Builder
classes.description: Inner interface for building instances of MessageMapperConfiguration with mutable property and condition maps.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the mapping configuration.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties as an unmodifiable map.

methods.name: getPropertiesAsJson
methods.description: Returns configuration properties as a JSON object.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns the conditions to check before mapping incoming messages.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns the conditions to check before mapping outgoing messages.

methods.name: findProperty
methods.description: Searches for a specific property by name, returning an Optional of its string value.

methods.name: <T> findProperty
methods.description: Generic method to find a property and validate its type with a predicate and cast it accordingly.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Extracts a required property by name or throws an exception if missing.

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Returns the content-type blocklist as a collection of strings.
